title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daron Payne to miss significant time with foot injury
items.desc: Commanders DT Daron Payne suffered a significant foot injury in practice on Friday that will knock him out for the foreseeable future.
items.impact: Payne will be further evaluated on Saturday. He is expected to be placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Turpin remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: George Pickens is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Pickens was limited in practice throughout the week. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Allgeier (toe) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Allgeier will return to his depth role with Jeremiyah Love slated to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Talanoa Hufanga has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Hufanga remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Waddle got in a pair of limited practices to end the week. He will be a borderline WR2/WR3 play for fantasy managers if he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: RJ Harvey (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: RJ Harvey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Harvey was a late addition to the injury report on Thursday. Jonah Coleman and J.K. Dobbins should both step into bigger roles in the Broncos backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Pat Surtain II is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Surtain will return in time for a crucial divisional matchup against Kansas City.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colston Loveland (neck) limited in practice Friday
items.desc: Colston Loveland was limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Loveland was a late addition to the injury report. He will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday heading into Monday's game against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) misses practice Friday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Monangai hasn't played or practiced since Week 4. He appears likely to remain sidelined this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Kerby Joseph has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: Joseph remains week-to-week. He will have a chance to return next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) will play Sunday
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown will play in Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: St. Brown is good to go despite missing practice to start the week on Wednesday. He will remain in his usual role for the Lions and fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) will play Sunday
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs will play on Sunday against the Vikings.
items.impact: Gibbs is good to go despite missing practice to start the week on Wednesday. He will remain in his usual role for the Lions and fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Bech (forearm) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jack Bech is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Bech practiced in full all week. It is unclear if he will be activated for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Carnell Tate has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Tate was unable to practice all week. Wan'Dale Robinson will be in the WR3/flex conversation even more so this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Spears missed practice all week. Tony Pollard will remain in a workhorse role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Tony Pollard is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Pollard got a rest day from practice on Thursday. He will remain an RB2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Calvin Ridley (hip) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Calvin Ridley is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Ridley remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Smith will miss another game for the Eagles alongside Dontayvion Wicks. They both remain week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Wicks will miss another game for the Eagles alongside DeVonta Smith. They both remain week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Jihaad Campbell has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Campbell didn't practice all week. He will be sidelined on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Stefon Diggs is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Diggs will be a WR3 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Treylon Burks has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Burks suffered a late foot injury in the Commanders last game. He'll need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre' Harris (hamstring) will play Sunday
items.desc: Tre' Harris is good to go for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Harris is good to go after the bye week. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (concussion) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: McConkey has been able to clear the concussion protocol. It has been a rough season injury wise for him. He remains a WR2 when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Derwin James Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: James recently suffered a setback in his recovery from a hamstring injury. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Greg Dulcich (ankle) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Greg Dulcich is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Dulcich will remain a TE2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Washington (knee) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Malik Washington is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Washington will remain in the WR4 range for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamree Kromah claimed off waivers by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins claimed EDGE Jamree Kromah off waivers from the Bears.
items.impact: Kromah will add depth on the defensive line for Miami.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) off injury report for Week 8
items.desc: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) is off of the injury report and will play for in Week 8 for the Philadelphia Eagles against the Washington Commanders according to Tom Pelissero.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Braelon Allen (ankle) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Braelon Allen (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Allen will be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report earlier in the week due to an ankle injury. He should be a full go in Week 8 and will be New York's primary running back if Breece Hall (quad) is unable to suit up against the Raiders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Parham is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's still dealing with a knee issue of some kind right now, and it may leave him sidelined against the Raiders. That will be bad news for New York's offensive front if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) set to play Sunday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Allen is set to play in Week 8. He was limited at practice earlier in the week due to a hamstring issue, but it's not a serious issue and won't prevent him from playing in Week 8. He isn't likely to be heavily involved moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenton Strange (eye) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Brenton Strange (eye) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Strange has been listed on the injury report throughout the week due to a minor eye issue, but it won't stop him from playing in a full capacity in Week 8. He may see more work than usual if Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is ruled out against the Colts.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Meyers was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Friday. He's now dealing with an ankle issue in addition to his nagging hamstring injury, and he is officially considered questionable to play. Brian Thomas Jr. and Brenton Strange may see more work if the veteran is unable to play against Indianapolis.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is officially off of Baltimore's injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: It was already reported that Jackson is set to make his return to the lineup on Sunday, but he is now off of the injury report entirely and will be a full go for Week 8. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him in this matchup, though they shouldn't be surprised if he isn't as active as a rusher in his first game back.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Simpson is officially good to go for Sunday's game, which has been expected all week despite his nagging groin issue. Baltimore's offensive line should be at nearly full strength for this matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) will play Sunday
items.desc: Ed Oliver (knee) will play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Buffalo's standout defensive tackle will be available to play on Sunday, despite being limited at practice earlier in the week with a knee issue. The team will need him to step up and play well if they want to contain a strong Baltimore offense on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ray Davis (illness) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Ray Davis (illness) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Davis missed Thursday's practice due to an illness of some kind, but he made his return on Friday and is not listed on the team's injury report heading into the weekend. He will be good to go for Sunday's game and will continue to play a depth role in this backfield behind James Cook III moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Ben Skowronek (calf) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The veteran wideout will have a chance to play on Sunday. His calf injury has left him sidelined for a little while, but he seems to be close to full health at this point. He won't be fantasy relevant moving forward, however, even if he's cleared to make his return to the lineup on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jared Verse (knee) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Jared Verse (knee) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Verse is off of the injury report heading into the weekend, meaning that he will be a full go against the Steelers. His presence is great news for Cleveland's defensive front ahead of this divisional matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Dylan Sampson (knee) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Sampson is set to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Cleveland's injury report earlier in the week with a knee issue. He isn't expected to see enough work to be fantasy relevant in this matchup, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins (knee) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Jenkins missed practice early in the week due to a knee issue, but he has received full clearance and will play for the Browns on Sunday. His presence will help Cleveland's offensive front substantially in a tough matchup against the Steelers this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson (rib) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Parkinson had missed practice to begin the week on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent McDuffie (groin) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Trent McDuffie is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: McDuffie is hopeful to return on Sunday. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luke Goedeke (calf) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Luke Goedeke is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Goedeke did not practice on Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell (hip) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Gainwell returned to a limited practice on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) misses practice Friday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Delane missed back-to-back practices to end the week. His status for Sunday's game against the Broncos is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring) will play Sunday
items.desc: Rashee Rice will return for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Rice will return for a big divisional matchup against Denver. He should return to being a borderline WR1/WR2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Jones returned to practice on Thursday and Friday. He will be an RB2/flex play for fantasy managers.
